implementation_notes: Implemented third concept at /preview/chromatic. user_directives.target_audience: Corporate hiring teams, talent leaders, and engineering hiring managers
user_directives.deferred_scope: Candidate-facing resume tools, candidate portals, and applicant tracking accounts remain deferred (still in discussion phase)
user_directives.background_rule: Preserve the light version background palette (--page #f7f6f0) exactly for the third preview. Do NOT change it to dark or cold stark white.
user_directives.content_filling_rule: Make boxes, cards, containers, callouts, and content highlights more colourful, energetic, and materially distinct, while avoiding chaotic multi-colour rainbow gradients.
user_directives.comparison_rule: Keep original Dark Precision and Light Editorial previews completely intact and accessible so stakeholders can compare all three directions directly.

archetype_fusion: Archetype 1 (Organic & Grounded Paper Base: unbleached linen #f7f6f0)
Archetype 3 (Tactile Color Blocking: saturated Venetian terracotta, deep French ultramarine, warm marigold)
Bauhaus / Swiss Exhibition Poster Layout: crisp structural geometry, high-contrast tinted ink surfaces, framed solid badge fills
concept_identity.emotional_tone: Warm, spirited, confident, intellectually vibrant, human-centered yet punchy
concept_identity.why_it_solves_user_problem: Existing Light Editorial is muted olive-green tone-on-tone on paper, creating an archival feel that felt 'too stale' or washed out. Chromatic Editorial retains the calm, warm #f7f6f0 foundation but energizes internal cards, scorecard containers, Nova folio, and workflow panels with saturated terracotta (#c2410c), French ultramarine (#1d4ed8), and rich warm amber accents. Surfaces gain distinct tinted fills (#fff4ed, #eff6ff, #fefce8) with bold 1.5px architectural borders rather than faint hairlines.

typography.pairing_strategy: High-Impact Modernist Display (Bricolage Grotesque) + Precision Humanist Sans (Manrope) + Monospace Telemetry (IBM Plex Mono)

design_notes_dialog_specification.title: Three directions. One clear product.
design_notes_dialog_specification.subtitle: All three concepts tell the exact same corporate story. Compare the lighting, typographic atmosphere, surface color-blocking, and card treatment.

cards.title: Dark Precision
cards.summary: Graphite (#0c0e10), warm amber (#f1b568), and acoustic telemetry. A high-density hardware studio aesthetic.

cards.title: Light Editorial
cards.summary: Warm paper (#f7f6f0), muted olive-green (#315b46), and DM Serif typography. Quiet, archival, and understated.

cards.title: Chromatic Editorial
cards.summary: Preserves the same warm paper base (#f7f6f0) while replacing muted fills with bold terracotta (#c2410c), French ultramarine, soft tinted card surfaces, and punchy Bricolage display headers.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.file_extension_rule: Use .js and .jsx files exclusively. Do not generate or convert to .tsx files.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.preserved_specs_rule: Do not delete or overwrite the design specifications for Dark Precision or Light Editorial. The third preview must coexist with them.
prohibited_elements: No generic rainbow multi-color gradients (e.g. purple-to-pink or blue-to-green shiny gradients).
No unverified statistical claims ('99.8% precision', 'zero hallucination', 'guaranteed hire').
No fake customer logos or unsupported ATS partner emblems (e.g. Greenhouse, Workday, Ashby badges).
No live calendar booking API connections or forms that submit user data.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_and_accessibility: All text on surfaces must exceed 4.5:1 contrast against its background. Headers must never exceed text-6xl (maximum 60px). Mobile breakpoints must retain touch-target sizes of at least 44px.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.interactive_preservation: All existing interactive states (Nova listening/thinking/speaking audio orb, Scorecard competency switching, Book a demo dialog, Design notes dialog) MUST remain 100% operational on all three routes.
